Evelyn: Hi, brand-new account following the quickstart (node sample). first POST to /v1/chat gave 402, then the SDK retried and I got 200. dashboard shows card attached. worried it billed twice. anyone seen this pattern? :grimacing:

Carlos: can you paste the exact SDK version and the HTTP logs (no API keys)? some SDKs used to retry too aggressively.

Evelyn: using redwood-js@1.0.0-next. logs: ```[2026-03-22T18:02:01Z] POST /v1/chat -> 402 {"error":"payment_required"}
[2026-03-22T18:02:01Z] SDK retrying request id=req_abc123
[2026-03-22T18:02:02Z] POST /v1/chat -> 200 {"id":"resp_xyz"}```

Pat: that looks like a client-side retry. 402 should be terminal. is your serverless platform retrying the request on error? sometimes providers auto-retry functions when they see certain failure signals.

Evelyn: running a small express app on a managed serverless edge platform. i pinned retry policy to 'none' in platform config, so shouldn't be provider-retry.

sdk-lead: we shipped a change in 1.0.0-next that accidentally treated all non-5xx errors with no explicit non-retriable flag as retriable. that would explain duplicate downstream requests and potential double billing. fix is to treat 4xx as terminal by default.

billing-ops: regarding double billing: our backend bills per-response token emission. if two successful responses are produced, that can show as two charges. we do have a short window where we can merge duplicate requests if they carry the same Idempotency-Key header. but chat generation calls rarely include idempotency keys by default.

Evelyn: is adding an Idempotency-Key safe for streaming generation? sample app is simple, would like an easy patch.

sdk-lead: recommend adding a lightweight idempotency header in the sample: ``Idempotency-Key: ${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8)}`` for non-streaming calls. for streaming, it's more complex; avoid SDK retries on 4xx instead. we'll publish 1.0.1 to fix retry policy.

Carlos: created minimal repro and confirmed that with the current SDK behavior a 402 -> 200 results in two billable responses. filed DX-1550: "SDK: do not retry on 4xx; sample apps should include idempotency-key pattern and guidance".

devex-bot: DX-1550 created and linked to runbook: https://internal.docs/redwood/devex/sdk-idempotency. Suggested quick fixes: pin sample deps to safe SDK, add Idempotency-Key snippet, and update quickstart UI text to not imply billing is the only failure cause.

billing-ops: short-term mitigation: add a dedupe step for identical near-simultaneous requests without idempotency keys when source IP and request body match and workspace is same. this reduces double-billing noise but will not replace the SDK fix.

Evelyn: thanks y'all. i'll pin the sample to 0.9.x for now and watch for 1.0.1. leaving a PR with the idempotency snippet and a note about billing toast confusion. :relieved:
